causal_interpretation: All first downstream divergences precede the first new decision; historical checkpoint priorities do not replicate v3 high activity. Counterfactuals intervene on later changed branches, not the already naturally implied variable at the checkpoint; cost similarity alone is not channel identification.
scope: Direct removal of a high-priority imminent branch is not the primary initiating carrier in these five actions; downstream branch choices can still mediate cost. Not a universal rejection of branch mediation.
